# `unused-import`

<!-- rule-docs:header (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
Tier: style · Profile: idiomatic · Default: off · Fixes: fix all · Options: none

Reports a private import alias that is never referenced.
<!-- /rule-docs:header -->

## Why it matters

Unused imports obscure actual dependencies and keep stale modules in review and
maintenance scope.

## When it fires

It applies to simple private top-level imports; public re-exports and uncertain
references are retained.

<!-- rule-docs:footer (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
## Example

```zig
const std = @import("std");
```
